actionResult.summary: Review 178 Explore：fresh-clone exact resume 与 real OpenSpec archive primitive evidence可复现，Verification sentinel方向正确；但 Explore 自己标记 Generic reusable subsystem=yes 却遗漏跨 Delivery Genericity/Next-consumer proof，且 Performance Proof F 在缺少 resume latency、selected check count、reopened finding count 等 required metrics 时仍宣告 PASS。两项均属于 Author 可修的 Explore evidence-boundary 缺口，因此 verdict=changes-requested。

reviewFindings.title: Generic Change CLI 缺少跨 Delivery next-consumer feasibility proof
reviewFindings.problem: 178 Risk Scan 明确把 G1 标为 generic reusable subsystem，但 Applicable Proofs 没有执行 Explore Skill v2 要求的 Genericity / Next-consumer Proof。现有 Evidence Boundary 只到当前 02 Delivery 的 production primitives / F1 boundary；而 G1 的 Change CLI 是 02 向 03 交接的长期 repository-level operator surface，必须证明不会依赖当前 Delivery/G1 identity，same-Delivery evidence不足以支撑该长期结论。
reviewFindings.contractRef: Flowkit Explore Skill v2 §4.5 Genericity / Next-consumer Proof；Change Execution Loop Delivery v4 §16 G1、§20 向 03 的稳定交接
reviewFindings.invariant: 声明为 generic reusable subsystem 且需要跨 Delivery 长期使用时，至少证明 current/synthetic A + different Change B + future-Delivery consumer；只有 Evidence Boundary 覆盖 Acceptance Boundary 才能 PASS。
evidence: 178 Risk Scan: Generic reusable subsystem = yes，理由为 CLI 面向任意 current Change。
Proof B 的 Evidence Boundary 仅为 current production Policy + execution services + F1 boundary tests。
Proof D 的 Evidence Boundary 明确仅到 underlying lifecycle primitives through F1 checkpoint boundary。
178 没有 future-Delivery-shaped consumer，也没有证明跨 Delivery Start/checkout 后 CLI intent/preparation/resume composition 仍不依赖 20260810 Delivery 或 G1 identity。
reviewFindings.impact: 如果直接进入 Proposal，可能把 Delivery-local locator、migration compatibility 或 current active-Change assumptions冻结进新的通用 CLI，问题要到 03 真正消费 G1 handoff 时才暴露，违反 Explore 把昂贵错误前移的目标。
reviewFindings.location: openspec/changes/change-cli-end-to-end-and-performance/explore.md §4 Risk Scan；§5 Proof A-D；§7.1 Thin Change CLI
reviewFindings.requiredOutcome: 在 Explore 内补一个最小 Genericity / Next-consumer proof：至少覆盖两个不同 Change identity，并增加 future-Delivery-shaped disposable consumer（跨新的 Delivery facts / checkout boundary），验证拟议 thin CLI intent resolution / preparation / resume 所依赖的现有 primitives 只消费 formal current facts，不依赖当前 02 Delivery、G1 identity、聊天或 provider state。无需实现最终 CLI，但 Evidence Boundary 必须到 future Delivery consumer。
acceptance: current/synthetic Change A 与不同 Change B 均可通过同一 intended composition 解析/准备对应合法 boundary，且无 identity hardcode。
future-Delivery-shaped fixture 在新的 Delivery facts 下仍可解析 active Change、Policy boundary并 prepare/resume one Standard Change Action。
证明不依赖 20260810-01-change-execution-loop、G1/F1/E2 literal、聊天摘要或 provider session；若 bounded historical migration literal存在，说明其不会决定 future CLI lifecycle。
记录 Acceptance Boundary / Evidence Boundary / Gap；只有 evidence 到 future Delivery consumer 才可 PASS。

reviewFindings.title: Performance Proof F 的 PASS 超过实际 Evidence Boundary
reviewFindings.problem: Proof F 自己把 Acceptance Boundary 写成“记录 required metrics 的可测 baseline”，但当前 evidence 没有记录 G1 v4 明列的 resume latency、selected check count、reopened finding count，却直接给出 PASS。`resume-context` diagnostic wall time 不能替代 exact resume/resumeRun latency；review convergence 的 <=2 Review Run 比例也不能替代 reopened finding count。
reviewFindings.contractRef: Flowkit Explore Skill v2 §5 Proof Acceptance Depth；Change Execution Loop Delivery v4 §16.3 Performance
reviewFindings.invariant: Proof Result=PASS 时 Evidence Boundary 必须覆盖其 Acceptance Boundary；G1 performance observation 应至少可测并区分所有 contract-required metrics，而不能用相邻指标替代。
evidence: Proof F 记录了 prepare、entry identity、diagnostics、focused/affected/full wall time、OpenSpec process count、Run average size、Review convergence。
未给出 exact resume/resumeRun latency baseline；仅有 resume-context≈1.92s。
未给出 selected check count 的 performance baseline。
未给出 reopened finding count；13/27 stage instances <=2 Review Runs 是另一指标。
Proof F 仍写 Result: PASS（performance observation requirement）。
reviewFindings.impact: Proposal 无法基于完整 baseline 冻结 G1 的 performance observation / non-regression contract，也会把 diagnostics latency、review rounds等相邻事实误当成 contract要求的不同指标。
reviewFindings.requiredOutcome: 补齐缺失的可测 baseline（至少 exact resume/resumeRun latency、selected check count、reopened finding count）并说明测量方法；或者把当前 Proof F Result 降为 UNKNOWN/partial，并在 Feasible Proposal Boundary 明确哪些指标尚未被 Explore 证明。不得在 Evidence Boundary 未覆盖时保留整体 PASS。
acceptance: 记录 exact resume/resumeRun 的 latency，而非仅 resume-context diagnostic latency。
记录 current representative Change Verification 的 selected check count。
从正式 Review lineage 统计 reopened finding count，并与 review rounds/convergence分开。
更新 Proof F 的 Acceptance Boundary / Evidence Boundary / Gap / Result，使 PASS 只覆盖实际已测事实。
